detail.longDescription: 🎓 NYT: How Trump Is Dismantling America’s Scientific Research Machine ｢ The number of Ph.D. applications from foreign students, typically a significant share of U.S. science programs, shrank by 21 percent this year at leading universities, according to data gathered for the Association of American Universities. Total Ph.D. admissions at those schools have dropped as universities try to make do with less resources ｣ https://www. nytimes.com/2026/10/31/science /how-trump-is-dismantling-americas-scientific-research-machine.html # science # research # doge # uspol
